VALUES ($1, $2, 'FORECAST', 'RUNNING', $3, UTC_TIMESTAMP())

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE(sold_at), '%Y-%m-%d') AS date,
       SUM(total_price) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM sale_records WHERE store_id = $1
GROUP BY date ORDER BY date

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE(sold_at), '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, menu_id, SUM(quantity) AS quantity
FROM sale_records WHERE store_id = $1
GROUP BY date, menu_id

INSERT INTO forecast_results
  (forecast_id, store_id, target_date, horizon_days, predicted_sales, interval_p10, interval_p90,
   is_low_confidence, low_confidence_reason, explanation, generated_at)
SELECT UUID(), $1, jt.target_date, jt.horizon_days, jt.predicted_sales, jt.interval_p10, jt.interval_p90,
       jt.is_low_confidence, jt.low_confidence_reason, jt.explanation, UTC_TIMESTAMP()
FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(FROM_BASE64($2) USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS (
  target_date DATE PATH '$.target_date',
  horizon_days INT PATH '$.horizon_days',
  predicted_sales INT PATH '$.predicted_sales',
  interval_p10 INT PATH '$.interval_p10',
  interval_p90 INT PATH '$.interval_p90',
  is_low_confidence TINYINT PATH '$.is_low_confidence',
  low_confidence_reason VARCHAR(32) PATH '$.low_confidence_reason',
  explanation JSON PATH '$.explanation'
)) AS jt
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  horizon_days = VALUES(horizon_days), predicted_sales = VALUES(predicted_sales),
  interval_p10 = VALUES(interval_p10), interval_p90 = VALUES(interval_p90),
  is_low_confidence = VALUES(is_low_confidence), low_confidence_reason = VALUES(low_confidence_reason),
  explanation = VALUES(explanation), generated_at = VALUES(generated_at)

DELETE fmi FROM forecast_menu_items fmi
JOIN forecast_results f ON f.forecast_id = fmi.forecast_id
WHERE f.store_id = $1 AND f.target_date IN (
  SELECT jt.target_date FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(FROM_BASE64($2) USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS ( target_date DATE PATH '$.target_date')) AS jt
)

INSERT INTO forecast_menu_items (id, forecast_id, menu_id, expected_quantity)
SELECT UUID(), f.forecast_id, jt.menu_id, jt.expected_quantity
FROM JSON_TABLE(CONVERT(FROM_BASE64($2) USING utf8mb4), '$[*]' COLUMNS (
  target_date DATE PATH '$.target_date',
  NESTED PATH '$.menu_forecast[*]' COLUMNS (
    menu_id CHAR(36) PATH '$.menu_id',
    expected_quantity DECIMAL(10,3) PATH '$.expected_quantity')
)) AS jt
JOIN forecast_results f ON f.store_id = $1 AND f.target_date = jt.target_date
WHERE jt.menu_id IS NOT NULL
